outcome: cognitive function scores at 12 months post-birth
motor function scores at 12 months post-birth
cohort: The study included 180 full-term neonates diagnosed with hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE).
finding: A combined model integrating MR-based radiomics signatures and clinical parameters demonstrated superior predictive performance for assessing the one-year prognosis of full-term neonates with HIE.
